fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-01-13 at roughly 19:10, it was reported that a disagreement over a boundary issue turned into a scuffle involving the complainant near Roja Park Main Street. The complainant, Arun Thangaraj, provided the contact number 9000000483. The complaint mentions Kishore Arumugam, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000189, in connection with the events. The complaint refers to Vignesh Balan, a friend of the suspect, reachable on 9000000105. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents, CCTV footage and photographs.
